\## Summary

Three independent but related fixes on merged main:

1. \*\*The system now recognises Chronus as its GPU.\*\* \`detect\_chronus()\` enumerates the Chronus contract device — derived from \`load\_spec()\`/\`topology()\` rather than probed hardware — as an integrated, host-unified, \`is\_gpu\` device. It runs first in \`detect\_all()\`, so \`default()\` selects it ahead of any physical backend; \`Device.seam\_selected\` therefore sees the contract identity (\`MLA1517 iGPU\` / \`hyba\`) instead of whatever card happened to be enumerated. Honest by construction: the record exists iff the contract loads, and claims only what the spec declares.

2. \*\*Every remaining blind sleep in the mining loops is now event-driven or env-calibrated.\*\*
- \`run\_execution\_loop\`: \`await asyncio.sleep(idle\_s)\` → \`asyncio.wait\_for(self.\_work\_wake.wait(), idle\_s)\` + \`clear()\` (same idiom as \`\_precompute\_loop\`). \`\_work\_wake\` is set on job arrival (\`search\_current\_job\`), stratum status (\`\_stratum\_sink\`), \`connect\_with\_failover\`, \`\_sync\_recovery\_gate\` edges, and work-identity rebind — any event that could make work available wakes the loop immediately instead of waiting out the slice.
- \`max\_backoff\_s\`: \`300.0\` literal → \`PYTHIA\_RECONNECT\_MAX\_S\` env (30 s default, validated via a local \`\_positive\_env\`), matching the calibrated cap \`production\_transport\` already uses. Lost hashrate is linear in reconnect latency; a 5-minute silent gap was out of spec.
- \`production\_transport\` not-permitted poll: same bounded \`\_work\_wake\` wait replaces \`asyncio.sleep(...)\`.
- \`cpu\_sweep\` was audited and left unchanged — rung budget is \`max(LANES, lucas(rung)−lucas(rung)%LANES)\`, lane-aligned, and respects the solver's \`budget ≤ lucas(scale\_index)\` invariant; no defect found.

3. \*\*Small main-drift repairs so the hard gates stay green:\*\*
- \`pyproject.toml\`: \`tensor\` + \`tensor.backends\` added to \`package-dir\`/\`packages\` — the package landed on main but was never shipped (pre-existing \`test\_package\_layout\` failure, verified red on clean \`origin/main\`).
- \`scripts/deploy\_sentry.py\`: \`mypy\`/\`ruff\` added to \`TOOL\_DISTS\` — the pythagoras merge put them in the dev extra (where they belong, same category as black/flake8/pytest) but the exemption list wasn't extended, so DS02's "declares X which nothing imports" flagged them (verified red on clean \`origin/main\`).
- \`docs/TENSOR\_ARCHITECTURE.md\` + testing SKILL.md: retired \`igpu.\`/\`igpu/\`/\`IGpuSku\`/\`mla1517\_platform\_v3.4\` literals retargeted so \`test\_chronus\_namespace\`'s token scan passes again (post-merge drift from the tensor PR).

## Verified on this box

- \`detect\_all()\` → \`\[('chronus', 'MLA1517 iGPU')\]\`; \`default()\` → \`chronus\`.
- \`pytest tests/test\_chronus\_detect.py test\_chronus\_namespace.py test\_package\_layout.py test\_system\_fabric.py test\_folded\_algebra\_honesty.py test\_aethel\_device.py\` — 33 passed.
- \`python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s chronus/mla1517\_platform/python\` — 348 tests, 1F+1E matching documented main parity (\`stale\_ratio\` 0.0-vs-None; \`allowed\`-vs-\`available\` envelope error), both verified pre-existing.
- \`python -m scripts.deploy\_sentry\` — 0 errors (was 2 on \`origin/main\`).
- \`flake8\` clean on all changed files.

Not verified here: hardware OpenCL calibration — this box has no GPU (only the IddSampleDriver virtual display); the contract-device path is what \`detect\_chronus\` covers, and physical-device calibration must run on real silicon.
